title: rpl_stack/mod.rs: pre-existing bad merge leaves unclosed delimiter (workspace won't build)
description: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/mod.rs:281-294 — merge commit 3d46a59502 (2026-09-09) spliced two competing RoutePlan return blocks: the first 'return Some(RoutePlan { next_hop, source_route,' is unclosed, then a second competing 'return source_route.first()...' block follows, producing 'mismatched closing delimiter' / 'unclosed delimiter' compile errors. lichen-node (and any dependent workspace build) fails to compile. Pre-existing, unrelated to the b7z9.120 SOS dispatch work (which touches only lichen-core). Blocks the lichen-node test suite.
close_reason: Not reproducible on main: the spliced/unclosed route_for block introduced by 3d46a59502 (beads-worker-3 merge) was already repaired on main by the worker-7 sync (267d544332, 2026-09-09 20:03 PDT, which replaced the region with the i72x.2 util::l2_destination version). Verified concretely: cargo check -p lichen-node passes on main@7404ccf455 (isolated target dir) and on beads-worker-1@777033c110; cargo test -p lichen-node runs the full suite (366 passed, 1 failed). The 1 failing test is a separate pre-existing regression, unrelated to the splice (fails on branches that never contained 3d46a59502 and predates it) — filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-jors. Bead filed ~9.5h after the fix landed; no code change needed. No files touched, so no codereview passes apply; noted hazard in comments: beads-worker-3 tip still carries the broken file and must be resolved to main's version at its next merge.
